scope: Independent static review of ConvNeXt-Tiny final-stage training, selection, loading and inference. No model training/inference performed by reviewer.
checks: Official checkpoint SHA is enforced and state loading is strict.
Prefix features[0:6] and copied final-stage features[6:8] split is structurally correct.
White RGBA composite, Lanczos letterbox 224 and ImageNet normalization match prior DINO implementation.
LayerNorm2d follows adaptive average pooling as in the original architecture; 768-to-7 head is trainable.
AdamW includes the final stage and final LayerNorm; nonzero pretrained gradient and parameter changes are verified.
model.train enables suffix stochastic depth only; validation and prediction call model.eval.
Gradient clipping, epoch budget, early stopping and immediate best-checkpoint serialization are consistent.
Best checkpoint is reloaded before saving validation probabilities.
Validation uses fixed ordered indices and explicit canonical class order.
Test prediction verifies checkpoint precision, split, model, class order and source provenance.
Resume restores optimizer, selected score, history and global torch RNG; DataLoader permutation is seeded per epoch.
Union-find combines RGB96 and RGB224 exact-image equivalence relations, including transitive chains.
Merged groups are checked against the unchanged outer split and passed to training-only StratifiedGroupKFold.
StandardScaler is fit inside each inner training fold; C selection sees only original training examples.
Final classifier is fit on the fixed training partition; portable coefficients, class order and predictor equivalence are checked.
